factors.name: Unit Economics Collection Confirmation Lag
factors.description: Ranks fresh quarterly gross-margin changes jointly with the opposite change in days sales outstanding, then scales the signed fundamental update by its same-day directional price-reaction deficit. High values identify credible but underreacted improvements in unit economics and cash collection.
factors.trading_idea: A simultaneous improvement in gross margin and decline in days-sales-outstanding is a cross-statement confirmation that a reported profitability improvement reflects healthier unit economics and cash collection rather than accounting timing or a temporary cost cut. The child trades only fresh quarterly updates and emphasizes cases where the same-day price response is weak in the direction implied by the joint update, predicting a six-day delayed assimilation as investors process the two statements jointly. It is falsified if fresh, collection-confirmed margin improvements with muted reactions do not outperform, and corresponding deteriorations do not underperform, over the following six bars; the edge can persist because this validation requires combining separate filing line items and distinguishing economically credible margin changes from cosmetic ones.

factors.name: Quality-Verified Surprise Attention Gap
factors.description: On fresh EPS-surprise updates, the signal buys positive and shorts negative cross-sectional surprises, weighted by income quality and by how muted the contemporaneous two-day price reaction was. It is zero outside fresh reporting events.
factors.trading_idea: A newly reported earnings surprise should drift over the next week when the initial two-day price response is unusually muted, because investors do not immediately process every quarterly disclosure. The effect should be stronger for firms with high operating-cash-flow-to-income quality, where the surprise is more likely to represent durable economic news rather than accrual noise. This remains difficult to arbitrage because identifying both report freshness and credibility requires point-in-time accounting data, while limited attention and institutional review delays create a short-lived assimilation gap. It is falsified if fresh high-quality surprises with muted initial reactions do not outperform equally surprising announcements that were immediately repriced.

factors.name: Per-Share Profit Convergence Disclosure
factors.description: Computes the fresh change in the gap between net-income growth and EPS growth, then retains that disclosure innovation for six bars. Higher scores correspond to a narrowing aggregate-profit versus per-share-profit wedge.
factors.trading_idea: A newly widening gap between aggregate net-income growth and EPS growth signals that reported business progress is not accruing to continuing shareholders, usually because dilution, option exercise, or a rising share base is absorbing the earnings gain. Investors and headline-oriented earnings screens often react first to aggregate profit growth, while the per-share shortfall is incorporated more gradually as portfolio managers reassess the sustainable ownership claim. The signal is long firms whose newly reported per-share growth has improved relative to aggregate-profit growth and short firms with a newly worsening wedge; the hypothesis is falsified if this direction does not predict relative returns over the next six trading days.

factors.name: Scalable Throughput Efficiency State
factors.description: Ranks a decayed filing-event score combining gross-margin expansion, inventory-turnover improvement, and DSO reduction, with greater weight when reported revenue growth is positive. The state persists for twelve sessions to capture gradual assimilation of scalable operational improvements.
factors.trading_idea: Operating-efficiency improvements are more credible when they occur alongside positive reported revenue growth: faster inventory turnover and collections during expanding sales indicate scalable execution, whereas the same working-capital changes during contraction can reflect liquidation, discounting, or collection pressure. The factor therefore conditions the parent triad on contemporaneous revenue-growth strength and carries the resulting filing state over a slower post-report assimilation period. This is falsifiable: conditional on the same margin, turnover, and DSO changes, high-growth names should have higher subsequent six-day returns and more favorable later estimate revisions than low-growth names. The edge can persist because investors initially react to headline margins while the distinction between demand-led throughput and balance-sheet harvesting requires reconciling several quarterly disclosure fields.

factors.name: Causal Return-Volume Analog Regime Forecast
factors.description: Constructs a trailing nearest-analog forecast by comparing the current three-bar path of return and log-volume z-scores with prior non-overlapping return-volume states. It ranks the similarity-weighted realized six-day outcomes of those past analog episodes.
factors.trading_idea: The signal treats the recent joint path of standardized returns and volume innovations as a market microstructure state, then forecasts from causally available historical episodes with the most similar state trajectory. Similar return-volume states can arise from recurring execution regimes such as institutional accumulation, distribution, or liquidity replenishment, whose effects extend beyond a single bar but are not captured by a univariate momentum signal. This is falsifiable: conditional on the same recent return path, names whose volume-return trajectory has historically matched episodes followed by positive six-day returns should outperform those matched to negative episodes. The edge may persist because analog matching requires state-dependent, cross-channel history rather than a transparent headline or simple technical threshold, and individual analogs are noisy enough to discourage immediate arbitrage.

factors.name: Self-Funded Credible Flow Propagation
factors.description: The signal activates for five bars after a fresh, credible positive EPS surprise at a self-funded expanding firm, then ranks contemporaneous sector-relative unpaid intrabar flow scaled by that event-quality state. Credibility penalizes tax-benefit-supported beats accompanied by working-capital growth and weak operating-cash-flow growth.
factors.trading_idea: A credible positive earnings surprise is more likely to represent durable information when the firm is expanding using operating cash flow rather than debt or equity issuance and when working-capital and tax signals do not contradict reported performance. In that state, persistent unpaid intrabar buying pressure is more likely to be informed investors and execution desks gradually repricing the new information, rather than an unrelated transient metaorder. The interaction has edge because fundamentals identify when flow direction is economically trustworthy, while residual flow identifies whether that otherwise slow-moving credible catalyst is still being incorporated over the next week.

factors.name: Option-Overhang Relief Digestive Drift
factors.description: Detects fresh quarterly reductions in SBC-to-revenue and in the diluted-to-basic share-count wedge, gates them on positive free-cash-flow yield, and applies a causal delayed-decay kernel so the signal expresses the accounting-information digestion period rather than the release-day reaction.
factors.trading_idea: A reported reduction in stock-based-compensation intensity is economically meaningful only when it is accompanied by a declining diluted-versus-basic share-count wedge: this indicates that the future per-share claim is improving rather than that compensation has merely been reclassified. Investors and many automated screens treat SBC as a non-cash accounting item and update diluted-share assumptions slowly, so the effect should diffuse over the following week, particularly for firms already generating positive free-cash-flow yield. This hypothesis is falsified if the return premium is equally strong when the dilution wedge does not improve, or among firms with negative free-cash-flow yield; the edge persists because option-overhang relief requires joining three separately reported accounting quantities rather than reacting to a headline price or volume pattern.

factors.name: Buffer-Validated Cost-Option Surprise Lag
factors.description: Ranks fresh positive revenue surprises that occur at high fixed-cost-slack firms with non-deteriorating short-debt-to-cash coverage and positive unpriced bullish participation. Scores are neutralized within industry and inactive outside fresh, buffer-validated events.
factors.trading_idea: A positive revenue surprise has a nonlinear equity payoff when a firm has substantial fixed-cost absorption room, but that payoff is credible only if its cash coverage of short-term debt is stable or improving. The refinancing-buffer state from Parent A therefore acts as a financing-feasibility veto on Parent B's operating-leverage event: a sales beat at a deteriorating borrower is more likely to be consumed by rollover risk, whereas the same beat at a buffer-resilient firm can translate into earnings. Bullish intrabar participation that exceeds contemporaneous price displacement identifies cases where informed buyers recognize this credible cost-option value before the price fully adjusts.

factors.name: Transient Probe-Origin Adverse Selection
factors.description: Computes volume-surprise-weighted downside and upside probes scaled by each name's trailing typical range, retaining only probes that substantially retrace before the close. An exponentially weighted recent imbalance is ranked cross-sectionally; high values indicate suspected sell-origin pressure despite an apparent intrabar recovery.
factors.trading_idea: A high-participation downside probe that is subsequently recovered can be temporary passive support against an informed sell program rather than genuine absorption: the low identifies the order-flow origin, while the recovery reflects dealers and contrarian liquidity temporarily warehousing inventory. Repeated, range-unusual downside probes should therefore precede negative six-day returns, whereas repeated upside probes should precede positive returns, because the initiating metaorder remains incompletely executed. This hypothesis is falsified if the signed probe-origin score has no negative forward-return relation after controlling for contemporaneous close-to-close return, intraday range, and relative volume; the edge can persist because daily bars reveal the temporary restoration but not the latent initiator or remaining execution schedule.

factors.name: Cash Reconciliation Headline-Chase Reversal
factors.description: Ranks positive EPS-surprise events by the combination of cash-margin deterioration, working-capital growth exceeding revenue growth, and an unusually strong report-day price reaction. High values flag headline-chased earnings reports with weak cash reconciliation and are expected to reverse.
factors.trading_idea: The parent result suggests that a superficially credible earnings beat should not automatically be interpreted as underreaction: investors can instead overpay for headline EPS when the supporting cash evidence is weak. This child identifies positive EPS beats that are chased immediately despite a contemporaneous deterioration in operating-cash conversion and an abnormal build in receivables or inventory relative to revenue; these are likely low-quality reported earnings whose reconciliation is completed over the following week. The hypothesis is falsifiable: among positive-surprise reports, high-score names should underperform low-score names over six trading days, with the spread concentrated where the report-day price response is strongly positive. The edge can persist because cash-flow and balance-sheet reconciliation requires cross-statement processing, whereas initial trading is dominated by the easily parsed earnings headline.

factors.name: Filing-Analog Concordance Exhaustion Reversal
factors.description: Computes a fresh, cash-confirmed surprise score discounted by its industry-residual price response, carries it briefly after the filing, and interacts it with a causal similarity-weighted forecast from historical return-volume paths. It takes the opposite side of the analog forecast only when the forecast direction agrees with the credible filing impulse.
factors.trading_idea: A cash-validated earnings surprise with a muted industry-relative initial reaction identifies a real information event, but does not reveal whether the surrounding trading state is fresh discovery or a pre-positioned execution regime. The return-volume analog component identifies states historically associated with continuation in the same direction; when that continuation state agrees with the filing direction, the combination is interpreted as crowded consensus confirmation and terminal inventory exhaustion rather than underreaction. The child therefore fades only concordant filing-and-analog states: the filing supplies a credible catalyst, while the analog regime supplies evidence that the catalyst has already been anticipated and is likely to trigger profit-taking over the next week.

factors.name: Auction-Probe Alignment Diffusion
factors.description: Computes a signed coherent overnight-ratchet state with partial intraday retracement, then gates it by an aligned, volume-weighted recovered intrabar probe direction.
factors.trading_idea: Coherent overnight auction repricing is weak as a standalone forecast because daytime liquidity provision can temporarily retrace the gap, but it becomes informative when high-participation intrabar probes reveal an independently aligned latent order-flow origin. A recovered upside probe following a positive auction ratchet, or a recovered downside probe following a negative ratchet, indicates that both the opening auction and the hidden intraday metaorder point in the same direction despite visible retracement. This agreement distinguishes continuing informed execution from a one-off gap or a purely temporary wick, creating a six-day diffusion signal neither parent identifies alone.

factors.name: Analyst Revision Close-Elasticity Wedge
factors.description: On fresh EPS-consensus revisions, the signal ranks the revision direction and subtracts the rank of the stock's volatility-standardized same-day return. It is high for upward revisions with muted price confirmation and low for downward revisions whose price response is too weak.
factors.trading_idea: Analyst-consensus changes are informative, but their immediate price impact varies with attention and investors' ability to interpret whether a revised estimate is economically durable. A positive estimate revision accompanied by an unusually muted same-day return indicates incomplete assimilation and should drift upward over the next week; the converse applies to downward revisions that receive an anomalously weak selloff. The hypothesis is falsified if, conditional on an estimate change, the six-day return is unrelated to the gap between revision direction and standardized same-day price response. The edge can persist because consensus updates are public but dispersed across sell-side channels and require costly interpretation of revision persistence rather than mechanical reaction to price alone.
